text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(This is—the JRA Tracen Academy. Soon... 
it'll be my Make Debut.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(The other Umamusume affiliated with the 
Central Tracen, who are about to make 
their debut just like me—)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Vodka, I'll make you realize. Just 
who is number one among our generation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Right back at you, Scarlet! The one 
cutting through the wind in the lead is 
gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving the two of them to their chatter, 
the one who swoops in and steals the prize 
is none other than this very Scarlet."

text_block_list.name: Daska & Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey!! Wait a second?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(All the Umamusume of my generation are 
playfully "messing around" together. On 
the surface, sparks are flying between 
them, but underneath...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(There's no predator-and-prey tension. And 
yet—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'm... different. I came charging in as a 
special exchange student from regional 
Funabashi Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is—enemy territory. Just standing 
here wears away at my spirit bit by bit...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The goal: "Defeat the JRA." It must be 
fulfilled. To prove the strength of 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Thank you for your hard work. 
It's finally time... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The "battle begins" in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is truly the "opening battle"

Yeah, this is truly "the start of the 
war."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having worked as a trainer at Funabashi 
Tracen, I came here together with Furioso 
as her partner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What we are trying to achieve isn't 
something as soft as 'making a dream come 
true.' This is...
choice_data_list:
This is a battle we absolutely can't 
afford to lose, right?

This is a battle we absolutely can't 
afford to lose, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we lose, it would mean Funabashi 
couldn't measure up to the Central League.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe Funabashi's Umamusume are 
lacking in talent. However, it's 
undeniable that our current ability falls 
short...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd be forced to watch 
such a humiliating race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A humiliating race. It was an inter-league 
graded stakes race held at Funabashi 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Diolite Kinen! They cross the finish 
line!! And the winner is—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Central's own Crimson Nova! And Central 
Umamusume sweep all the way through 4th 
place!! And then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
3.3 seconds! It's 3.3 seconds! Left behind 
by a massive margin.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No... No way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Funabashi Umamusume suffered a 
crushing defeat by a massive 3.3-second 
margin to the winning JRA Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We cannot let things end like this. At 
this rate, the JRA will take everything 
from us...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Prestige, the spotlight, our pride, 
everything... If we can't catch up to the 
Central..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Our home turf, Funabashi Racecourse, will 
steadily lose its fans. What's more..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The town around the racecourse might end 
up completely desolate too. The beloved 
town... where we grew up...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—We must prevent it at all costs. To do 
that, we have to beat the JRA first.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's aim to become the Dirt King!
Yeah, let's aim to be the Dirt King!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the Central or Funabashi, 
dirt is dirt. On the sand, I can make full 
use of the strength I've cultivated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the JRA dirt Umamusume are 
strong. But if you use the JRA facilities 
and train as a special exchange student, 
I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, that will be all for 
today. I'll be in your care again 
tomorrow.
choice_data_list:
Furioso, what are you doing after this 
today?

Furioso, what are you doing after this 
today?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you mean? Well, I'll just 
head back to my room like usual...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I was planning on just eating some salad 
chicken alone tonight, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dining all alone. It feels like such a 
lonely sight...
choice_data_list: Then let's have a meal together.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... Well then, since you offered. 
Thank you as always.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much. For joining 
me for dinner tonight as well.
choice_data_list: No, I don't mind at all.
No, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso doesn't live in the Tracen Academy 
dorms. She rents an apartment off-campus 
and lives alone, but...
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't it be more convenient to move 
into the dorms?

Wouldn't it be more convenient to move 
into the dorms?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, that is the one thing I cannot do. The 
JRA is—the enemy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If we lived together under one roof, too, 
I feel like I'd end up getting completely 
absorbed...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"We are assassins from Funabashi. Our 
comrades are just the two of us. The only 
one we can let our guard down around is 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I have to make absolutely sure never to 
cross this line.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please don't let yourself be swayed 
either, Trainer. And then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us surpass Central, claim everything, 
and bring spring to Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we have nothing to our names. 
All we have is the faint warmth of being 
from the same hometown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the bond shared by those from 
Funabashi is exceptionally strong. 
Together, we will definitely conquer the 
Central.
